verses.en: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
verses.pt: Aquele a quem forem trilhados os testículos, ou for cortado o membro viril, não entrará na assembléia do Senhor.
verses.en_web: He who is emasculated by crushing or cutting shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
verses.en_bbe: No man whose private parts have been wounded or cut off may come into the meeting of the Lord's people.

verses.en: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the LORD.
verses.pt: Nenhum bastardo entrará na assembléia do Senhor; nem ainda a sua décima geração entrará na assembléia do Senhor.
verses.en_web: A person born of a forbidden union shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one of his enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
verses.en_bbe: One whose father and mother are not married may not come into the meeting of the Lord's people, or any of his family to the tenth generation.

verses.en: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the LORD for ever:
verses.pt: Nenhum amonita nem moabita entrará na assembléia do Senhor; nem ainda a sua décima geração entrará jamais na assembléia do Senhor;
verses.en_web: An Ammonite or a Moabite shall not enter into Yahweh’s assembly; even to the tenth generation shall no one belonging to them enter into Yahweh’s assembly forever;
verses.en_bbe: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their people to the tenth generation may come into the meeting of the Lord's people:

verses.en: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way, when ye came forth out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.
verses.pt: porquanto não saíram com pão e água a receber-vos no caminho, quando saíeis do Egito; e, porquanto alugaram contra ti a Balaão, filho de Beor, de Petor, da Mesopotâmia, para te amaldiçoar.
verses.en_web: because they didn’t meet you with bread and with water on the way, when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.
verses.en_bbe: Because they gave you no bread or water on your way, when you came out of Egypt: and they got Balaam, the son of Peor, from Pethor in Aram-naharaim to put curses on you.

verses.en: Nevertheless the LORD thy God would not hearken unto Balaam; but the LORD thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee, because the LORD thy God loved thee.
verses.pt: Contudo o Senhor teu Deus não quis ouvir a Balaão, antes trocou-te a maldição em bênção; porquanto o Senhor teu Deus te amava.
verses.en_web: Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam; but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord your God would not give ear to Balaam, but let the curse be changed into a blessing to you, because of his love for you.

verses.en: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever.
verses.pt: Não lhes procurarás nem paz nem prosperidade por todos os teus dias para sempre.
verses.en_web: You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.
verses.en_bbe: Do nothing for their peace or well-being for ever.

verses.en: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he is thy brother: thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a stranger in his land.
verses.pt: Não abominarás o edomeu, pois é teu irmão; nem abominarás o egípcio, pois peregrino foste na sua terra.
verses.en_web: You shall not abhor an Edomite; for he is your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.
verses.en_bbe: But have no hate for an Edomite, because he is your brother, or for an Egyptian, for you were living in his land.

verses.en: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.
verses.pt: Os filhos que lhes nascerem na terceira geração entrarão na assembléia do Senhor.
verses.en_web: The children of the third generation who are born to them may enter into Yahweh’s assembly.
verses.en_bbe: Their children in the third generation may come into the meeting of the Lord's people.

verses.en: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.
verses.pt: Quando te acampares contra os teus inimigos, então te guardarás de toda coisa má.
verses.en_web: When you go out and camp against your enemies, then you shall keep yourselves from every evil thing.
verses.en_bbe: When you go out to war and put your tents in position, keep from every evil thing.

verses.en: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:
verses.pt: Se houver no meio de ti alguém que por algum acidente noturno não estiver limpo, sairá fora do arraial; não entrará no meio dele.
verses.en_web: If there is among you any man who is not clean by reason of that which happens him by night, then shall he go outside of the camp. He shall not come within the camp;
verses.en_bbe: If any man among you becomes unclean through anything which has taken place in the night, he is to go out from the tent-circle and keep outside it:

verses.en: But it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash himself with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp again.
verses.pt: Porém, ao cair da tarde, ele se lavará em água; e depois do sol posto, entrará no meio do arraial.
verses.en_web: but it shall be, when evening comes, he shall bathe himself in water. When the sun is down, he shall come within the camp.
verses.en_bbe: But when evening comes near, let him take a bath: and after sundown he may come back to the tents.

verses.en: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:
verses.pt: Também terás um lugar fora do arraial, para onde sairás.
verses.en_web: You shall have a place also outside of the camp where you go relieve yourself.
verses.en_bbe: Let there be a place outside the tent-circle to which you may go;

verses.en: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:
verses.pt: Entre os teus utensílios terás uma pá; e quando te assentares lá fora, então com ela cavarás e, virando-te, cobrirás o teu excremento;
verses.en_web: You shall have a trowel among your weapons. It shall be, when you relieve yourself, you shall dig with it, and shall turn back and cover your excrement;
verses.en_bbe: And have among your arms a spade; and when you have been to that place, let that which comes from you be covered up with earth:

verses.en: For the LORD thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.
verses.pt: porquanto o Senhor teu Deus anda no meio do teu arraial, para te livrar, e para te entregar a ti os teus inimigos; pelo que o teu arraial será santo, para que ele não veja coisa impura em ti, e de ti se aparte.
verses.en_web: for Yahweh your God walks in the middle of your camp, to deliver you, and to give up your enemies before you. Therefore your camp shall be holy, that he may not see an unclean thing in you, and turn away from you.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord your God is walking among your tents, to keep you safe and to give up into your hands those who are fighting against you; then let your tents be holy, so that he may see no unclean thing among you, and be turned away from you.

verses.en: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee:
verses.pt: Não entregarás a seu senhor o servo que, fugindo dele, se tiver acolhido a ti;
verses.en_web: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who has escaped from his master to you.
verses.en_bbe: Do not give back to his master a servant who has gone in flight from his master and come to you:

verses.en: He shall dwell with thee, even among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it liketh him best: thou shalt not oppress him.
verses.pt: contigo ficará, no meio de ti, no lugar que escolher em alguma das tuas cidades, onde lhe agradar; não o oprimirás.
verses.en_web: He shall dwell with you, among you, in the place which he shall choose within one of your gates, where it pleases him best. You shall not oppress him.
verses.en_bbe: Let him go on living among you in whatever place is most pleasing to him: do not be hard on him.

verses.en: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
verses.pt: Não haverá dentre as filhas de Israel quem se prostitua no serviço do templo, nem dentre os filhos de Israel haverá quem o faça;
verses.en_web: There shall be no prostitute of the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: No daughter of Israel is to let herself be used as a loose woman for a strange god, and no son of Israel is to give himself to a man.

verses.en: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD thy God for any vow: for even both these are abomination unto the LORD thy God.
verses.pt: não trarás o salário da prostituta nem o aluguel do sodomita para a casa do Senhor teu Deus por qualquer voto, porque uma e outra coisa são igualmente abomináveis ao Senhor teu Deus.
verses.en_web: You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, or the wages of a male prostitute, into the house of Yahweh your God for any vow; for both of these are an abomination to Yahweh your God.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take into the house of the Lord your God, as an offering for an oath, the price of a loose woman or the money given to one used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods: for these two things are disgusting to the Lord your God.

verses.en: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother; usury of money, usury of victuals, usury of any thing that is lent upon usury:
verses.pt: Do teu irmão não exigirás juros; nem de dinheiro, nem de comida, nem de qualquer outra coisa que se empresta a juros.
verses.en_web: You shall not lend on interest to your brother; interest of money, interest of food, interest of anything that is lent on interest.
verses.en_bbe: Do not take interest from an Israelite on anything, money or food or any other goods, which you let him have:

verses.en: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.pt: Do estrangeiro poderás exigir juros; porém do teu irmão não os exigirás, para que o Senhor teu Deus te abençoe em tudo a que puseres a mão, na terra à qual vais para a possuíres.
verses.en_web: You may lend on interest to a foreigner; but to your brother you shall not lend on interest, that Yahweh your God may bless you in all that you put your hand to, in the land where you go in to possess it.
verses.en_bbe: From men of other nations you may take interest, but not from an Israelite: so that the blessing of the Lord your God may be on everything to which you put your hand, in the land which you are about to take as your heritage.

verses.en: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the LORD thy God, thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the LORD thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.
verses.pt: Quando fizeres algum voto ao Senhor teu Deus, não tardarás em cumpri-lo; porque o Senhor teu Deus certamente o requererá de ti, e em ti haverá pecado.
verses.en_web: When you vow a vow to Yahweh your God, you shall not be slack to pay it; for Yahweh your God will surely require it of you; and it would be sin in you.
verses.en_bbe: When you take an oath to the Lord, do not be slow to give effect to it: for without doubt the Lord your God will make you responsible, and will put it to your account as sin.

verses.en: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.
verses.pt: Se, porém, te abstiveres de fazer voto, não haverá pecado em ti.
verses.en_web: But if you refrain from making a vow, it shall be no sin in you.
verses.en_bbe: But if you take no oath, there will be no sin.

verses.en: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform; even a freewill offering, according as thou hast vowed unto the LORD thy God, which thou hast promised with thy mouth.
verses.pt: O que tiver saído dos teus lábios guardarás e cumprirás, tal como voluntariamente o votaste ao Senhor teu Deus, prometendo-o pela tua boca.
verses.en_web: You shall observe and do that which has gone out of your lips. Whatever you have vowed to Yahweh your God as a freewill offering, which you have promised with your mouth, you must do.
verses.en_bbe: Whatever your lips have said, see that you do it; for you gave your word freely to the Lord your God.

verses.en: When thou comest into thy neighbour’s vineyard, then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel.
verses.pt: Quando entrares na vinha do teu próximo, poderás comer uvas conforme o teu desejo, até te fartares, porém não as porás no teu alforje.
verses.en_web: When you come into your neighbor’s vineyard, then you may eat of grapes your fill at your own pleasure; but you shall not put any in your container.
verses.en_bbe: When you go into your neighbour's vine-garden, you may take of his grapes at your pleasure, but you may not take them away in your vessel.

verses.en: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour’s standing corn.
verses.pt: Quando entrares na seara do teu próximo, poderás colher espigas com a mão, porém não meterás a foice na seara do teu próximo.
verses.en_web: When you come into your neighbor’s standing grain, then you may pluck the ears with your hand; but you shall not move a sickle to your neighbor’s standing grain.
verses.en_bbe: When you go into your neighbour's field, you may take the heads of grain with your hand; but you may not put your blade to his grain.
